chapter_seo_title: Sun Star Palace Opens: Ancestral Gods Gather for Celestial Treasure
chapter_meta_description: The Sun Star Palace of a Stone Man King emerges. Ancestral Gods, monarchs, and mysterious old men converge. Xiao Chen reluctantly enters with a reckless guide.
